baseline: Conceptual 4,652 m² catchment: roofs 1,404 m², road union 2,128 m², green strips 1,120 m². Rain depth × area / 1000 gives m³. Green roofs hold up to 20 mm with no release during an experiment. Permeable paving infiltrates up to 15 mm/h; green strips 8 mm/h. Remaining surface water routes instantly to collection. Optional garden captures collection inflow up to its configured m³ capacity; no release. Drain removes 0.8 × nominal mm/h × catchment area / 1000, limited by available water. Collection holds 150 m³; excess is reported as overflow. Initially dry; no evaporation, travel time, soil saturation, groundwater, or calibrated flood depth. Coverage is uniformly distributed across each category.
